data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: recovery
sections.summary: The process of becoming well again after an illness, injury, or operation.

senses.definition: the process of becoming well again after illness, injury, or an operation; the return to a normal state of health
examples: The doctor said her recovery would take at least three weeks.

answers.answer: Recovery is a type of hospital.

sections.question: routine
sections.summary: A regular sequence of activities done at a set time as part of a daily habit.

senses.definition: a regular sequence of activities or tasks that are done at a set time as part of an established habit or programme
examples: He has a morning routine that includes stretching and a healthy breakfast.

answers.answer: She has a daily exercise routine.
A routine is a medical wound.

sections.question: schedule
sections.summary: To plan or arrange that something will happen at a particular time.

senses.definition: to plan or arrange that an event, appointment, or operation will happen at a particular time
examples: We have scheduled the next checkup for the end of the month.

answers.answer: The surgery is scheduled for Monday.
A schedule is a type of medicine.

sections.question: symptoms
sections.summary: Physical or mental signs that indicate a person may have a particular illness.

senses.definition: physical or mental signs that indicate a person may have a particular illness; changes in the body that suggest something is wrong
examples: Common symptoms of flu include fever, headache, and tiredness.

answers.answer: He described his symptoms to the doctor.

sections.question: therapy
sections.summary: Treatment of a physical or mental illness, especially without surgery or medicine.

senses.definition: the treatment of a physical, mental, or behavioural condition, often through exercises, talking sessions, or other non-surgical methods
examples: He attended speech therapy sessions twice a week to improve his communication.

answers.answer: She started therapy after the accident.
Therapy is a type of prescription paper.

sections.question: treatment
sections.summary: Medical care given to a patient for an illness or injury.

senses.definition: the medical care given to a patient for an illness, injury, or condition; a way of dealing with a health problem
examples: The new treatment for the condition has shown very positive results.

sections.question: urgent
sections.summary: Needing immediate action or attention; very important and requiring quick response.

senses.definition: needing immediate action or attention; very important and requiring a quick response
examples: The patient's condition was urgent so the doctor saw him straight away.

answers.answer: This is an urgent medical case.

sections.question: well-being
sections.summary: The state of being comfortable, healthy, and happy in body and mind.

senses.definition: the state of being comfortable, healthy, and happy in terms of both physical and mental health
examples: Getting enough sleep has a major effect on your overall well-being.

sections.question: workout
sections.summary: A period of physical exercise, especially one done at a gym or as part of a fitness routine.

senses.definition: a period of physical exercise, especially one done at a gym or as part of a regular fitness routine
examples: She does a thirty-minute workout every morning before breakfast.

answers.answer: He does a workout at the gym every day.
A workout is a type of surgery.

sections.question: wound
sections.summary: An injury to the body, especially a cut or damage to the skin caused by something sharp.

senses.definition: a physical injury to the body, especially a cut or break in the skin caused by something sharp or by an accident
examples: He kept the wound clean and covered until it healed completely.

answers.answer: The nurse cleaned the wound carefully.
A wound is a medical certificate.
